Sprint 1 was a resounding success. The team designed, developed, tested, reviewed, and accepted all core MVP user stories for the To-Do List Web App, providing a fully functional web interface where users can create lists, add tasks, toggle completion states, delete tasks, and delete lists with cascading task clean-up.
